spans.s: Same,Ⓒa.Ⓓtad (pron. a.) with or without eva; aBinna, nirviSeza, ananya, sama, samAna, tulya; See Like; ‘it is the s(ame) Vāsantī’ sEva vAsaMtI; te eva pAdapAH; tadeva vanaM &c. (

); gen. by eka, sa, sama, samAna in comp.; ‘of the s(ame) family’ sagotra; ‘sitting in the s(ame) car’ ekasyaMdana-mAMsTitO, ‘of the s(ame) age’ samavayaska; ekarUpa, samAnajAti, sodara &c.; ‘at the s(ame) time’ ekadEva, yugapat, eka-sama-kAle, samaM, yOgapadyena; ‘in the s(ame) way’ tadvat, taTEva, taTA, evaM; ‘he is the s(ame) as a father to me’ mAM prati sa pitfsTAne-BUmO vartate, pitfnirviSezaH.
Ⓝ[Same]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹEkyaM, sAmyaM, eka-rUpatvaM, sAdfSyaM, saMvAdaH, aBedaH, samaBAvaH; ‘s(ameness) of class’ savarRatA, sAvarRyaM, ekavarRatA.
